title: When Repeated Measurements Hurt Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on IID benchmarks, but how do they respond to repeated measurements at the same inputs? Across six TFMs, synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments show that additional measurements can improve predictions at measured inputs while degrading them elsewhere. Harm is most frequent at low noise, and irrelevant features amplify it in several models; real repeated-measurement datasets show similar patterns. Statistically, the IID rule targeted by PFN pretraining treats each repeated input as fresh evidence about the input distribution. When the prior links this distribution to the response function, the resulting protocol mismatch can outweigh the benefit of additional measurements, even under exact inference. Computationally, interventions identify row-count dependence in TabPFN-v3's attention scaling as a contributor to harm. Resetting the count largely reverses distortion i

translated_title: 重复测量何时会损害表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）在独立同分布（IID）基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但它们如何应对相同输入处的重复测量呢？在六个表格基础模型上进行的合成与半合成实验表明，额外的测量可以改善已测量输入处的预测，同时使其他位置的预测变差。这种损害在低噪声情况下最为常见，并且在多个模型中无关特征会放大这种损害；真实的重复测量数据集也显示出类似模式。从统计学角度看，PFN预训练所针对的IID规则将每个重复输入视为关于输入分布的新证据。当先验分布将这一分布与响应函数联系起来时，由此产生的协议不匹配可能会超过额外测量带来的好处，即使在精确推理下也是如此。从计算角度看，干预实验确定了TabPFN-v3注意力缩放机制中对行数的依赖是造成损害的一个因素。重置行数可以在很大程度上逆转这种失真。
tldr: 该研究发现表格基础模型在面对相同输入的重复测量时，会因PFN预训练的IID规则与实际协议不匹配以及注意力机制对行数的依赖，导致未测量输入处的预测性能下降。
en_tdlr: Tabular foundation models can be harmed by repeated measurements at the same inputs, as IID-based PFN pretraining misinterprets repeated inputs as fresh evidence and row-count-dependent attention scaling introduces distortion, degrading predictions at unmeasured locations.
